_: Dry and humid air near sea level (ISA 15 C, and room 20 C), with a `wind` block for outdoor scenes: Beaufort speeds, gusts, turbulence, the log profile near the ground, and the drag coefficients of the shapes it pushes (a head, a hair fibre, cloth). World lane 2026-11-07.

n.src: CIDDOR96: classic 0 C STP value; 1.000277 at 15 C, 550 nm (Ciddor)

scattering.v: Rayleigh (lambda^-4): the blue sky; aerosol (Mie) adds haze; 23 km visibility clean air

density_kg_m3.src: ISA; 20 C D from p/(R T)

humidity_effect.v: humid air is LESS dense than dry at the same p and T (M_w 18 < 29): at 30 C, 100 % RH ~1.5 % lighter; n - 1 drops slightly; sound a bit faster
humidity_effect.src: ideal-gas mixture with saturation vapour pressure (CRC)

phase.src: SCHEMA: gas is non_colliding. Air never blocks a solid; it acts on bodies only through drag, lift, buoyancy and pressure

model.v: drag only: F = 0.5 rho |u_rel| u_rel Cd A (wind.drag coefficients); buoyancy rho_air V g; a hair fibre per unit length 0.5 rho u^2 Cd d

damping_ratio.v: aerodynamic: linearised drag c = rho u Cd A per body

sound_speed_m_s.src: ISA; 20 C D from sqrt(gamma R T)

conductivity_W_mK.src: ETB air properties table (Engineering ToolBox, re-read 11-08; a secondary source): 25.87 mW/mK at 20 C, 1 atm; corrected from 0.0257 (CRC, recalled)

heat_capacity_J_kgK.src: ETB specific heat of air table (Engineering ToolBox, re-read 11-08; a secondary source): cp 1.006 kJ/kgK at 288.7-300 K, 1 bar; corrected from 1005 (CRC, recalled)

emissivity.src: not found: a gas layer; use sky temperature for radiative exchange

v.2: leaves rustle, wind felt on face
v.4: raises dust, loose paper; small branches move; hair blown
v.6: large branches move, umbrellas hard to use

turbulence_intensity.src: STULL88: E: recalled from STULL88, not re-read (was M); STULL88 / WIERINGA92 class ranges (recalled)

formula.v: u(z) = (u_star / kappa) ln(z / z0), kappa = 0.41; above a canopy use z - d (zero-plane displacement ~2/3 canopy height)

z0_m.src: WIERINGA92: E: recalled from WIERINGA92, not re-read (was M); WIERINGA92 Davenport classes

head_height_vs_10m_open_grass.src: ln(1.7/0.03)/ln(10/0.03): wind at head height is ~70 % of the 10 m (Beaufort) value

sphere_Cd.src: HOERNER65: E: recalled from HOERNER65, not re-read (was M); HOERNER65

cylinder_Cd.src: HOERNER65: E: recalled from HOERNER65, not re-read (was M); HOERNER65 / White

hair_fibre_Cd.src: White's cylinder fit with Re = u d / nu, d 70 um, nu 1.51e-5 m2/s; per unit length force = 0.5 rho u^2 Cd d

flat_plate_normal_Cd.src: HOERNER65: E: recalled from HOERNER65, not re-read (was M); HOERNER65 (square plate ~1.05-1.17); cloth flapping adds a dynamic term

flat_plate_parallel.v: skin friction only: Cf ~ 1.33 Re^-0.5 laminar (Blasius), ~0.074 Re^-0.2 turbulent
flat_plate_parallel.src: HOERNER65: E: recalled from HOERNER65, not re-read (was M); HOERNER65 / standard boundary-layer results

standing_human_CdA_m2.src: cycling/pedestrian wind literature: upright person ~0.5-0.9 m2 (recalled, not re-checked)

humid_30C_100RH.src: ideal-gas mix: dry 1.164 at 30 C minus the vapour (4.24 kPa) effect (CRC saturation pressure)

cold_0C.src: ideal gas p/(R T), sqrt(gamma R T) at 273.15 K

ISA.cite: ICAO Doc 7488 / ISO 2533:1975 International Standard Atmosphere: sea level 101325 Pa, 288.15 K, 1.225 kg/m3, 1.7894e-5 Pa s, 340.29 m/s
ISA.lic: standard copyright; defining constants used as facts

CIDDOR96.cite: Ciddor PE. Refractive index of air: new equations for the visible and near infrared. Appl Opt 35:1566 (1996); via refractiveindex.info (n-1 = 2.77e-4 at 550 nm, 15 C, 101325 Pa, dry, 450 ppm CO2). n 1.000293 is the classic 0 C STP figure

CRC.cite: CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics (any recent edition): standard property tables for water, ice, air, oils. Values recalled as standard table values, not re-checked line by line this session
CRC.lic: copyright, paywalled; individual physical constants used as facts, no table copied

CODATA18.cite: CODATA 2018 recommended values (NIST): c = 299792458 m/s exact, sigma = 5.670374419e-8 W m-2 K-4 exact, k_B, standard atmosphere 101325 Pa, g_n = 9.80665 m/s2 (CGPM 1901)
CODATA18.lic: NIST, US government work, public domain

WMO_BEAUFORT.cite: WMO Manual on Codes (WMO-No. 306) / WMO Guide to Meteorological Instruments (WMO-No. 8): Beaufort scale equivalent wind speeds at 10 m (m/s); WMO-TD 1555 (2010) Guidelines for converting between various wind averaging periods: gust factors ~1.2-1.6 over land
WMO_BEAUFORT.lic: WMO publications, free; numbers used as facts

WIERINGA92.cite: Wieringa J. Updating the Davenport roughness classification. J Wind Eng Ind Aerodyn 41:357-368 (1992). Recalled: z0 ~0.0002 sea, 0.03 open grass, 0.1 crops, 0.5-1 suburbs, >=2 city centres
WIERINGA92.lic: paywalled; class values used as facts

HOERNER65.cite: Hoerner SF. Fluid-Dynamic Drag (1965) and White FM. Fluid Mechanics / Viscous Fluid Flow: sphere Cd ~0.47 subcritical, drag crisis Re ~3e5; long cylinder Cd ~1.0-1.2 (1e3<Re<2e5) and White's fit Cd = 1 + 10 Re^-2/3 (1<Re<2e5); flat plate normal to flow Cd ~1.17-1.28 (square ~1.05-1.17). Recalled textbook values
HOERNER65.lic: books, copyright; standard coefficients used as facts

STULL88.cite: Stull RB. An Introduction to Boundary Layer Meteorology. Kluwer (1988): log law u(z) = (u*/kappa) ln(z/z0), kappa ~0.40-0.41; near-surface turbulence intensity ~0.1-0.3

PREETHAM99.cite: Preetham AJ, Shirley P, Smits B. A practical analytic model for daylight. SIGGRAPH 1999

HOSEK12.cite: Hosek L, Wilkie A. An analytic model for full spectral sky-dome radiance. ACM TOG 31(4) (SIGGRAPH 2012); reference code ArHosekSkyModel (as shipped in Blender intern/sky and OSPRay)
HOSEK12.lic: code BSD-3-Clause (Blender/OSPRay SPDX headers; checked by search 11-07): usable commercially with attribution

ANON_E.cite: Estimate made in this lane; the reason is given in each src

ETB.cite: The Engineering ToolBox: Air - thermal conductivity vs temperature and pressure (2009); Air - specific heat capacity (2004)
ETB.lic: free web tables, copyright; single numbers used as facts, tables not copied (secondary source)
